candidate.provenance_boundary: PR #9 explicitly declares its exact factor formulas and strategy parameters to be newly authored reconstruction proposals, not recovered GP V1.1 authority.

factors.candidate_formula_summary: mean of normalized 5-day and 20-day market adjusted-close returns
factors.recovered_source_difference: Recovered V3.10 partial regime evidence is based on cross-sectional market breadth state; historical design also requires prior-day limit-up performance and first-30-minute volume for the full regime layer. No exact historical return-only formula is recovered.
factors.decision: Do not promote candidate formula as historical.

factors.recovered_source_difference: V3.10 file-backed panel code computes daily advance/decline counts and breadth ratios, so the input family overlaps; the five-day mean mapping, signed normalization and final factor aggregation are not recovered historical rules.
factors.decision: Preserve as proposal with file-backed input overlap only.

factors.candidate_formula_summary: mean normalized sector-minus-market relative returns for 5/10/20 sessions
factors.recovered_source_difference: The accepted V1.0 framework confirms Sector RS and the 5/10/20 sector-minus-market concept, but candidate scales 0.03/0.05/0.10 and arithmetic aggregation are newly authored proposal details.
factors.decision: Factor identity and horizons are historical; exact candidate formula is not.

factors.candidate_formula_summary: 20-session log-price OLS slope times R-squared normalized by 0.10
factors.recovered_source_difference: Slope-times-R2 identity is confirmed, but exact log transform, 20-session production window, scaling and normalization are not recovered from authoritative historical source bytes.
Sector Breadth identity and weight are user-confirmed, but exact numerator/denominator, PIT sector membership, five-session averaging and signed mapping remain unrecovered.
factors.decision: Keep candidate formula unapproved and non-historical.

factors.recovered_source_difference: V3.10 Daily Base exactly computes pos20, pos60 and pos120 rolling range-location features, so the feature family and windows overlap. The candidate inversion, equal averaging and final score mapping are not recovered historical rules.
factors.decision: Reuse only the recovered feature semantics, not candidate aggregation.

factors.recovered_source_difference: Recovered V3.10 Daily Base raw_strength explicitly uses r5/r10/r20/r60/r120 and awards 20 points for each positive horizon. Candidate omits r120 and replaces raw_strength sign-counting with scaled continuous averaging.
factors.decision: Candidate formula cannot be treated as recovered historical Multi-Momentum.

factors.candidate_formula_summary: 60-session log-price slope times R-squared normalized by 0.20
factors.recovered_source_difference: Recovered V3.10 trend_quality is an explicit threshold score using slope20, R2_20, er20 and close_loc; candidate instead uses a pure 60-session slope/R2 expression and therefore conflicts with the recovered file-backed Daily Base component.
factors.decision: Do not promote candidate F8 formula as historical.

factors.candidate_formula_summary: signed 20-session displacement divided by summed absolute path movement
factors.recovered_source_difference: V3.10 Daily Base computes ER10 and ER20 with the same displacement-over-path family, and er20 participates in recovered trend_quality. The final historical Efficiency Ratio horizon selection, sign treatment and score mapping are not recovered.
factors.decision: Feature overlap is valid; final candidate factor formula remains proposal-only.

factors.candidate_formula_summary: 60-session latest-peak, post-peak-trough recovery mapped to a signed score
factors.recovered_source_difference: V3.10 Daily Base file-backed features include dd20 and dd60, proving drawdown inputs existed; the candidate latest-peak/trough recovery formula and normalization are newly authored and are not recovered historical code.

factors.candidate_formula_summary: five-session price efficiency plus capped main-net-flow intensity and sign persistence
factors.recovered_source_difference: V3.10 prepare_ashare21_hf.py only proves a 17-column historical fund-flow input-preservation adapter. It does not recover the candidate main_net_flow/amount scaling, pulse cap, five-session persistence, turnover normalization or final Price/Fund formula.
factors.decision: Input adapter is historical partial evidence; candidate F11 scoring formula remains new and unapproved.

factors.candidate_formula_summary: mean normalized return across exactly five closed 15-minute bars and five closed 60-minute bars
factors.recovered_source_difference: Historical architecture confirms separate 15-minute and 60-minute execution confirmation, but no authoritative source recovers candidate five-bar windows, 2-percent/4-percent scales, averaging or confirmation/negation rules.
factors.decision: Keep F12 formula proposal-only until historical source or a new explicit adoption decision exists.
